artworks.title: Augustus II, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man is posed facing forward with his body turned slightly to his right. He has a mustache and a pointed beard, styled hair, and wears elaborate clothing from a historical period style. Surrounding the portrait is an inscription, with Latin text below it, alongside the engraver's signature and date, "L. Kilian. sculps: 1621." The background is filled with a hatched pattern.

artworks.title: Augustus II, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image is a historical portrait engraving of a man's upper half. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a mustache and goatee, with wavy, light-colored hair. He is dressed in an ornate outfit with intricate patterns and a large ruff collar. The portrait is in an oval frame with Latin inscriptions. Outside the frame, there are allegorical figures; one is looking at a mirror and another is holding scales. The background has decorations with symbols like an open book and a globe, suggesting scholarly themes. Latin text is also present at the bottom of the engraving.

artworks.title: Augustus II, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He is shown slightly angled, facing left, with his body turned to the side. The man has a mustache, beard, high hairline, and wavy hair brushed back. He wears a textured garment with an ornate ruff around his neck, typical of 17th-century noble attire. Surrounding him is an oval frame with Latin inscriptions. The background within the frame is dark and patterned, while outside there are decorative elements like foliage and scrolls. Objects such as armor, a globe, and books are depicted at the bottom of the engraving.

artworks.title: Augustus, Duke of Saxony
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of an older man within an ornate oval frame. The man has a serious expression, featuring a prominent forehead, full beard and mustache, and short, receding hair. He is portrayed wearing elaborate armor with a ruffled collar. The frame surrounding the portrait is intricately decorated with foliage, figures resembling classical statues, and heraldic symbols. The background is filled with ornamental designs. The artwork is dated 1582 at the bottom center.

artworks.title: Melchior Ayrer, Philosopher and Doctor
artworks.description: The image is a half-length portrait of a man. His facial features include a long, full beard and a mustache, with a serious expression. He is wearing a dark cap on his head. The man is dressed in a heavy fur-lined cloak with intricate detailing. Underneath, he wears a dark tunic. Around his neck, he wears a chain with a round medallion. In his right hand, he holds a book and his other arm rests on a table covered in fabric. The background is a textured monochrome backdrop with an ornate coat of arms to the man's left and text at the top, indicating his name and titles.

artworks.title: Gervase Babington, Bishop of Worcester
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is a portrait drawing of a person from the waist up. The person is seated and turned slightly towards their right. They have a beard, mustache, and wear a cap that covers most of their hair. The person has a neutral expression and deep-set eyes. They are dressed in elaborate historical clothing, including a ruffled collar and a dark robe. The person holds a book in their left hand, and the background features inscriptions including the name "Gervasius Babington" and Latin text.

artworks.title: Gervase Babington, Bishop of Worcester
artworks.description: This image shows a middle-aged man facing slightly to the right, holding a book in front of him. The man has a long, full beard and mustache, deep-set eyes, and a high forehead. He wears clothing typical of the Renaissance era, including a wide-collared garment with voluminous sleeves and intricate details. The man's hair is partially covered by a cap. The background is plain with a decorative banner containing text, as well as additional text above and below the image. The engraving style emphasizes the texture of the clothing and the man's expression.

artworks.title: John Babington, Pyrotechnia
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various mechanical devices and decorative illustrations. In the center, there is a text titled "PYROTECHNIA Or a Discourse of Artificiall Fireworks for Pleasure." Surrounding the text are sections depicting machines, gears, tools, a fortress, horses, and mythological creatures. At the bottom, there is a detailed portrait of a man within an ornate oval frame, showcasing traditional fashion of the time. The image conveys a sense of scientific exploration and creative artistry in mechanical pyrotechnics from an earlier era.

artworks.title: Anna, Lady Bacon, Daughter of Sir Anthony Cooke and Wife of Sir Nicolas Bacon
artworks.artist: Henry Richard Cook, after Sylvester Harding
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of Anna Lady Bacon, focusing on the upper half of her body. She is depicted in a slightly angled forward-facing position, looking directly at the viewer. Her facial features are detailed with a composed expression, and she has short hair styled with an intricate lace headpiece. She is dressed in elaborate clothing typical of the Elizabethan era, featuring a high ruffled collar and a richly patterned gown with dark embroidered details. No jewelry or objects are visible within the portrait. The background is a plain, textured surface that frames the figure in an oval vignette. The image is presented on a large piece of paper with details of the painting and its provenance inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Anna, Lady Bacon, Daughter of Sir Anthony Cooke and Wife of Sir Nicolas Bacon
artworks.artist: Henry Richard Cook, after Sylvester Harding
artworks.description: The illustration is a portrait of Anna Lady Bacon shown from the shoulders up, with her body positioned slightly turned to the side, her head facing forward. Her facial features are delicately rendered, with a gentle expression, prominent eyes, and well-defined eyebrows. She has short hair that is covered by a finely detailed lace cap. She is dressed in a richly ornamented gown with a detailed lace ruff encircling her neck, and her attire is intricately decorated with patterns. This portrait is set against a dark, stippled background that contrasts with the lighter tones of her attire and face. The illustration is framed within an oval border on paper with text beneath identifying her as "Anna Lady Bacon."

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man identified as Lord Bacon, depicted from the waist up. He is positioned slightly to the side, facing forward. The man has a prominent mustache and a narrow, pointed beard. His hair is styled close to the scalp, wavy, and covers his ears. He is dressed in period attire with a ruffled collar and a patterned garment with decorative detailing on the shoulders. There is no visible jewelry or objects held. The background of the image is plain with a light tone, and the portrait is framed within a simple rectangular border with some decorative corners.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a person's upper body, capturing the head and shoulders. The individual is Lord Bacon, as indicated by the text below the image. He is positioned facing slightly to his right while maintaining eye contact with the viewer. The man's facial features include a mustache and a goatee, and he has wavy hair that peeks out from beneath a wide-brimmed, tall hat adorned with feather-like decorations at the top. His attire consists of an elaborate, dark robe or coat with detailed patterns on the sleeves, and he wears a prominent, wide, ruffled collar. Surrounding him is a textured oval frame, set against a background of plain paper that shows signs of age. Above the image is the title "Literary Magazine & British Review," and below the oval frame, his name "Lord Bacon" is inscribed in capital letters.

artworks.title: Monument of Bacon in Saint Michael's Church, Saint Albans
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a figure seated with intricate details on the clothing, including ornamental patterns and a broad, ruffled collar. The figure wears a hat and has a beard. The sculpture is monochrome, displayed in shades of gray. It is placed within an arched niche and the figure is seated on an ornate chair. Below the sculpture, there is a large plinth or pedestal with inscriptions in Latin.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a person named "Lord Bacon." The individual depicted has well-defined facial features, a mustache, a small pointed beard, and dark, wavy hair peeking out from under a large, broad-brimmed hat. They are wearing historical attire, including a large lace ruff around the neck and a decorated garment with intricate details. The background is a simple, textured pattern. The inscription beneath the portrait reads "Lord Bacon" and includes the publisher's name "London: Routledge."

artworks.title: Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man identified as Lord Bacon. He is facing the viewer with a slightly turned posture. The man has a full beard, mustache, and wavy hair that curls at the ends. He wears a high, wide-brimmed hat, a ruffled white collar, and elaborately decorated dark clothing. The background is a dark, textured surface. The name "Lord Bacon" is inscribed below the image, along with a partial publisher's mark on the lower right side.

artworks.title: Lord Bacon, "Knowledge is Power"
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper torso of a person identified as "Lord Bacon." He is positioned facing slightly to the viewer's right, capturing head and shoulders. His facial features include a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a beard and mustache that are neatly presented. His hair is medium-length, a bit curly, and hidden under a large black hat. He wears a dark clothing ensemble, richly decorated with intricate patterns, and a wide, elaborate white ruff collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain, displaying only the details of the etching. At the bottom of the image, there is text providing information about Lord Bacon and detailing his death and commemorations. The text and portrait are centrally positioned on the paper with wide margins.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting in a chair with ornate carvings and a high backrest. He is facing forward and slightly to the left, with his right hand holding open a book on a desk in front of him. The man has a pointed beard and mustache, with wavy hair partially covered by a tall, flat-topped hat. His facial expression is neutral, and his eyes are focused on the viewer. He wears an elaborate outfit with a ruffled collar, a decorated coat, and a pendant hanging from his neck. The desk is cluttered with books, an ink pot, and a quill. In the background, there is a shield with a coat of arms and Latin text within a decorative wreath at the top.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon, Lord Verulam
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man named S. F. Bacon. He is depicted facing slightly to his left with his body turned in a three-quarter view. The man has distinct facial features, including a prominent forehead, a well-groomed beard and mustache, and curly shoulder-length hair. He is wearing a dark robe with an ornate pattern and a large white ruffled collar. The portrait is framed in an oval frame, with the name "S.F. BACON" inscribed below in a decorative plaque. The background has a textured pattern forming an octagonal design around the portrait on aged paper.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon, Lord Verulam
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter length portrait engraving of a man identified as "Francis Bacon," standing with his left hand resting on a table. He has a full face with distinct facial features, including a mustache and a goatee. His hair is curly and reaches down to the collar, framing his face. The man is wearing ornate clothing, featuring a richly embroidered cloak with a high ruffed collar. The sleeves of his garment are intricately designed with elaborate patterning and lace cuffs. A portion of a hat is visible on the table beside him. The background of the image is plain with no significant details, keeping the focus on the figure. The engraving is set on a textured and slightly stained paper with printed and handwritten text at the bottom identifying him as Francis Bacon and attributing the engraving to a portrait gallery.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up, seated in an ornate oval frame. The man has distinct facial features, a short beard, mustache, medium-length wavy dark hair under a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a dark, elaborately patterned garment with large shoulder pads and a white ruffled collar. The portrait is surrounded by decorative elements with an inscription. Below the portrait, a small figure is depicted with curly hair and minimal clothing, holding a scepter. To the right of the figure are scrolls and a book. The background features intricate engravings. The top of the engraving mentions it was made for the "Universal Magazine," and a publication note is at the bottom for J. Hinton at Kings Arms in Newgate Street.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image is a portrait illustration of a man's upper torso and head. The man is facing slightly to the right with a calm expression. He has a beard, mustache, and curly hair under a wide-brimmed hat. He is dressed in a period-style outfit with a ruffled collar, typical of the early 17th century. The background is plain with light specks, and there is text below the portrait that reads "BACON." The paper shows signs of aging with foxing visible around the portrait.

artworks.title: The Great Lord Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body standing with his left hand resting on a table. The man has a substantial mustache and a closely trimmed beard. His medium-length curly hair extends just past his ears. He is wearing elaborate clothing with intricate embroidery, a ruffled collar, and lace cuffs. There are no visible items of jewelry. The background is plain and dark, with no specific details visible beyond the man's attire. The image is captioned "The Great Lord Bacon" and notes that it was published in London.
